events.text: Start a throwaway simulator and centre on probe ports with isolated state.

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; mkdir -p /tmp/t033v; SIM_PORT=8893 SIM_STATE=/tmp/t033v/sim.json nohup python3 cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py > /tmp/t033v/sim.log 2>&1 &

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply local D1 migrations and wait for servers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; DB=$(grep -o '"database_name": *"[^"]*"' wrangler.jsonc | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); echo $DB; yes | npx wrangler d1 migrations apply $DB --local --persist-to /tmp/t033v/state 2>&1 | tail -3; for i in $(seq 1 30); do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8961/); [ "$c" != 000 ] && break; sleep 2; done; echo centre $c; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "sim %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8893/

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run both delivery probes against local centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; export CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8961 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8893; node app/scripts/probe-day-delivery.mjs > /tmp/t033v/pdd.txt 2>&1; echo "day exit $?"; grep -c PASS /tmp/t033v/pdd.txt; grep -v "^PASS" /tmp/t033v/pdd.txt | head; node app/scripts/probe-output-delivery.mjs > /tmp/t033v/pod.txt 2>&1; echo "out exit $?"; grep -c PASS /tmp/t033v/pod.txt; grep -v "^PASS" /tmp/t033v/pod.txt | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run Tantra reminders probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8961 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8893 node scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs > /tmp/t033v/ptr.txt 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; grep -c "^PASS\|ok " /tmp/t033v/ptr.txt; grep -i "fail" /tmp/t033v/ptr.txt | head -5; tail -2 /tmp/t033v/ptr.txt
